profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Cisco (Splunk) | Backend Systems, Real-time Platforms & User Interfaces
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer with 25 years of experience designing and shipping backend systems, real-time platforms, simulation engines, intuitive user interfaces, and clean APIs.

I focus on making both APIs and user interfaces easy to understand and enjoyable to use. I’ve shipped two 5-star rated apps on the App Store, along with several well-regarded internal tools and systems at Sony Imageworks, PrecisionHawk, and Splunk.

I tend to simplify systems relentlessly. I’m happiest when I can solve a complex problem by reducing it to small, obvious, composable pieces. I build dedicated test harnesses and simulation tools to make this aggressive simplification safe and verifiable.

Notable work includes:
• Led backend architecture and real-time systems for LATAS, PrecisionHawk’s drone monitoring platform -- reducing codebase size by over 50% while supporting live drone operations and NASA UTM scenarios.
• Core contributor and reviewer for OpenTelemetry Python at Splunk/Cisco, with strong focus on developer experience, clarity, and maintainability.
• Designed and delivered production user interfaces and supporting APIs across digital film production, drone operations, enterprise storage, and observability instrumentation.

Practitioner and advocate of AI-assisted development to increase productivity, quality, and scope.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Core reviewer and contributor to OpenTelemetry Python
* Author of Splunk's Distribution of OpenTelemetry Python
* Designed and built OtelTest, an integration test framework for OpenTelemetry Python distributions
* Original designer and author of widely used Collector components including File Receiver, SQL Query Receiver, Collector Configurator, Configuration Schema, Dotnet Receiver, Kubelet Stats Receiver, Redis Receiver, and a web-based Collector configuration tool
